uncited: Base-NeRF uses a specific architecture with hash grids and MLPs for its proposal networks.
Proposal 2 queries 96 samples using probability density sampling.
The architecture uses Hash Grids with parameters (levels/log2 size/base/max) and MLPs (layers/dimension).
Positional embedding uses standard encoding, directional embedding uses spherical harmonics.
This variant prunes rays corresponding to background regions based on an importance threshold.
On the Blender dataset, this yields large speedups because many pixels correspond to the background.
*   **Time Complexity:** The method reduces the number of network queries compared to uniform sampling of the same total sample count by focusing queries on relevant regions.
However, it adds the overhead of the coarse pass.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Requires storing parameters for both coarse and fine networks.
It was designed to address the high computational cost of volume rendering in neural implicit representations.
